resources.string: Skip-Ad Guardian companion service (do not enable manually)

Managed automatically by Skip-Ad Guardian. Do not enable manually.

Helps automation work in some apps and keeps Skip-Ad Guardian running in the background.

Accessibility capabilities are disabled; only the service remains running, with minimal overhead. Some apps may still detect accessibility as enabled.
Skip-Ad Guardian touch optimization (do not enable manually)
Managed automatically by Skip-Ad Guardian. Do not enable manually.\n\nReads screen content and matches rules. The privileged service performs clicks and swipes to reduce touch stutter.
Automatically taps the skip or close buttons shown by apps based on built-in subscription rules.\n\nScreen content is read in memory only and never uploaded; data stays on this device.
